convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicator. Simple crossover entry/exit with signal-reversal close. Percentage-based position sizing with loss-decrease logic. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic (FrameGenerator.mqh is only for backtest optimization visualization, not trading). No custom indicators, no grid, no hedging.

derived_values.name: Optimized lot size based on free margin and risk percentage

other_exits: Position closed via trade.PositionClose(_Symbol,3) when opposite crossover signal occurs on the same bar the existing position is checked

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Base lot = FreeMargin * MaximumRisk / margin_per_1_lot. If DecreaseFactor>0 and consecutive losing deals exist, lot is reduced by lot*losses/DecreaseFactor. Lot is then normalized to SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP and clamped to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN..SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses bar[0] open vs close relative to MA: SELL when open > MA and close < MA (price crossed below MA within the bar); BUY when open < MA and close > MA (price crossed above MA within the bar). New-bar guard uses rt[1].tick_volume > 1 check (only trades on first tick of new bar). No SL/TP set on PositionOpen (0,0 passed). Close uses deviation=3. Bars(_Symbol,_Period)>100 required as minimum bar count before trading allowed. TERMINAL_TRADE_ALLOWED check before both open and close. The FrameGenerator.mqh include and CFrameGenerator are purely for strategy tester optimization visualization and do not affect live trading logic.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. iMA maps directly to pandas TA or ta-lib SMA. Entry logic: compare bar open/close against MA value on completed bar. New-bar guard translates to checking for new candle formation. Position sizing: calculate lot from account free margin * risk_pct / margin_per_lot, then apply loss-decrease factor by iterating trade history for consecutive losses. No SL/TP simplifies conversion. The loss-decrease lot logic requires trade history access. FrameGenerator functionality can be ignored for Python conversion as it is backtest-visualization only. Note the entry uses rt[0] (current forming bar) open and close vs MA, which in backtesting acts as next-bar-open fill since new-bar guard ensures execution only on first tick.
